name: DARKNESS — free horror escape backgrounds & props (2D)
summary: All background art and props from etomo-studio's small Unity horror escape game DARKNESS: 4 concrete/iron-door/pipe corridor backgrounds at 1672×941 plus transparent props (rusty key, lever, crack overlay), an eye close-up, a memo note and the title illustration. Handy for escape-room, visual-novel or horror jam games.

access.license: etomo-studio terms (commercial use OK, credit optional)
access.notes: Terms stated on the itch page only, no license file in zip. Itch flags graphics as AI-assisted. Game and sound effects not included.

procedure: Click Download Now, then 'No thanks, just take me to the downloads' (or pay what you want).

verdict.why: Fresh, genuinely free pack with commercial use allowed, download verified (10 files). Small, AI-assisted art and terms only on the itch page, so modest score.
